neighbours.label: ' the' in a counting partitive, 'N of the <count> ...' / 'Of the <count> ...', where a number or quantity is about to follow (the opposite pole fires on ' the' where a quantity has just been given and a definite noun follows)
fire: By the end of the week, only 7 of the 30 applicants had been interviewed.
Inspectors found faults in 14 of the 52 bridges they examined last year.
When the votes were counted, of the 200 delegates only a handful objected.
After the storm, just three of the eleven boats returned to the harbour.
According to the report, 45 of the 120 schools have no library at all.
In the final round, of the sixteen teams entered, six came from abroad.
Doctors said that 9 of the 25 patients recovered within a month.
So far, only two of the eight reactors have been restarted.
quiet: By the end of the week, the manager of the hotel had resigned.
Inspectors found faults in the deck of the bridge they examined last year.
When the votes were counted, the mood of the delegates turned sour.
After the storm, the captain of the ferry returned to the harbour.
According to the report, the roof of the school has leaked for years.
In the final round, the coach of the team shouted from the bench.
Doctors said that the health of the patient improved within a month.
So far, the owner of the plant has refused to comment.

notes: Card: top examples 'one of the more than 3 million', '35 of the 650', 'Of the 15 countries'; the output direction promotes ' numerous', ' many', ' dozens', number words. Probes: '12 of the 40' 0.62, 'Of the nine' 0.56, 'Two of its four' 0.36, 'a third of the villagers' 0.27; 'roof of the old barn' 0.04.
